How to read the graph

Each box is a meaningful part of the claim. Solid green lines show support relationships; red dashed lines show conflicts; amber dashed lines show constraints that can limit the final supportable amount.

What does “Resolution Path” mean?

This section answers: “What additional evidence could change the current result, and under what condition?” It does not automatically raise the claim. It tells a reviewer what to submit or resolve next.

Run an analysis to see the evidence that could change the result.

What does “Support Replay” mean?

Replay shows how the deterministic support result changes as specific evidence is added or removed. It is a repeatable explanation of the decision—not a second AI judgment.
